_comment: Process monitor: samples resource use per process, flags threshold crossings, sends critical ones to EdgeSentinel.
Roles below are built from the exe names actually observed on the GFF rig's discovery log on 10 Sep 2026.

sampling._note_handle_probe: Triggered, never on cadence: whole-machine handle snapshot when a handle_probe role rises by delta, plus one baseline per process start after min_seconds of stability. Types only, never names.

output._note: chain_every_rows sets how much of a LIVE file is unverified. 6 = a checkpoint a minute; costs 422 KB/day of sidecar, 74 MB over 180 d. 30 = five minutes, 15 MB.

_comment: Names here are suppressed from the discovery log; tracked exes are already excluded.
Anything left below is genuine workstation noise on this rig and does not earn 13 columns.
Columns clients may push. Declared here because the schema freezes before the first row.

client_sid MUST be narrowed from AU before production. NOTE: 'IU' was tried and killed IPC outright -- use the account SID from: wmic useraccount where name='ATM_USER' get sid. 3.0.6 warns at startup if the pipe fails to open.

health._note: 3.2 health link for EdgeBastion. EdgeVitals observes and answers; EdgeBastion decides and acts. Separate pipe from ipc.pipe: different audience, different ACL. EdgeTerminal heartbeat = {"hb":1,"role":"ui"} every 5 s on the EXISTING metrics pipe. In service mode the window check is always unknown (Session 0 cannot see the desktop), so the heartbeat is the hang signal.
health._note_defaults: Brief defaults (6 Oct 2026). ceiling_mb 0 = use the role's ram_budget_mb; set it from a measured p99 before field use, or 80% of the budget will warn on a healthy EdgeTerminal. cpu_stall_hang stays false: idle SPs legitimately accrue no CPU.

processes.label: EdgeTerminal
processes._note: 17-24 Sep, four sessions: private 1313-1382 p50 but RESIDENT only 293-333. Budget tracks the resident set; the commit gap is the in-process Vosk model.

processes.label: EdgeSignal-Vision
processes._note: tier=transaction: face_cover GATES the UI, so ESV can halt a transaction. Measured 435 MB / 29.5% core / 5370 cpu-sec, four sessions. Matches plain python.exe on this rig. CAUTION: python.exe, python3.11.exe and pythonw.exe match ANY Python process on the terminal, and all of them are summed into vision. Ship ESV under its own exe name (edgesignal-vision.exe), then delete the three python entries.

processes.label: Vosk ASR (in-process today)
processes._note: Never binds yet: ASR is in-process, and the ~1050 MB commit gap in ui_ is its model. Re-baseline once split out.

processes.label: Piper TTS
processes._note: Measured (n=2): 168 MB p50, 191 max, 0.00% CPU when caught. Short-lived; a 1 s run is needed to characterise it.

processes.label: Rhubarb lip-sync
processes._note: Over the old 60 MB on every sighting: 63/148/155/208 MB across four days. Caught ~7% of runs at 10 s sampling.

processes.label: EdgeSignal-Content
processes._note: Idle most of the time; spikes during patch or content delivery.

processes.label: NATS leaf node
processes._note: Not seen on the GFF rig on 10 Sep -- expect this role to stay empty.

processes.label: EdgeBastion
processes._note: Not yet shipped; 40 MB is a design target, not a measurement.

processes.label: EdgeVitals (self)
processes._note: self:true binds by PID -- a rename must never leave the agent blind to itself.

processes.label: EdgeXfsBroker
processes._note: Measured 3.5-3.7 MB, 0.00% CPU, four sessions. Handles moved -8/+99/+126 -- watch, do not act. On the dispense path.

processes.label: VoizeTTS server
processes._note: Added Oct 2026. Replaces Piper for EdgeTerminal prompts; loopback-only server. CONFIRM the exe name on a terminal (tasklist /fo csv) and keep only the real one(s): a name that matches nothing leaves voize_* empty, never an error. Budgets 0 (none) until a baseline session is measured. Keep the piper role until Piper is gone from every terminal.

processes.label: TransBridge (UPI QR cardless)
processes._note: Added Oct 2026. CONFIRM the exe name. If TransBridge runs inside EdgeTerminal rather than as its own process, delete this role: its cells would stay empty forever and only add columns. Budgets 0 until measured.

processes.label: Vendor XFS / device runtime (Perto)
processes._note: Six managers under C:\Perto\Managers; row is the SUM, xfs_pid shows only the first. Handle climb tracks EdgeTerminal RECONNECTS (+10 with no restarts, +188/+352/+404 with them), not probe runs.

processes._note: Live on the GFF rig; mpcmdrun is the on-demand scanner and spikes hard.
